item.title: UMaine men’s basketball earns 1st conference win of season
item.description: UMaine shot 61.9% from the field and 63.6% from three-point range as a team, led by TJ Biel's 11 points.

item.title: Grateful Dead founding member Bob Weir dies at 78
item.description: Weir wrote or co-wrote and sang lead vocals on Dead classics including “Sugar Magnolia,” “One More Saturday Night” and “Mexicali Blues.”

item.title: UMaine women’s basketball uses strong second half to upend NJIT
item.description: The Black Bears outscored the New Jersey Institute of Technology 33-16 over the final 14:18 of the contest to earn an 86-67 triumph.

item.title: Providence completes weekend sweep of UMaine men’s hockey with shutout win
item.description: Providence came into the weekend ranked 17th in one national poll and 18th in the other while UMaine was 12th and 14th.

item.title: The Golden Globes are tonight. Here’s what to look for and how to watch and stream the show
item.description: The Golden Globes bill themselves as Hollywood’s booziest bash. This year, is anyone ready to party? Political tension and industrywide uncertainty are the prevailing moods heading into Sunday night’s 83rd Golden Globes. Hollywood is coming off a disappointing box-office year and now anxiously awaits the fate of one of its most storied studios, Warner Bros. […]

item.title: I’m still pining for my Uncle Albert’s Marble’s ax
item.description: "It was the perfect size for me, and just as I was with Aunt Sandy’s cake and cookies, I became obsessed with the little ax."

item.title: Why do Maine deer hunters hate coyotes?
item.description: There are few things that frustrate Maine deer hunters more than the Eastern coyote, but the furbearer is here to stay.

item.title: Why I keep returning to this Maine river after 40 years
item.description: Much like sports have done since Grant accepted Lee’s sword at the end of the Civil War, it was brook trout that drew my wife and me to the Rangeley Lakes Region of western Maine. item.title: Here’s why these anglers can’t wait for the Long Lake Derby
item.description: The prizes aren’t what hooks the stalwarts who return each year. It’s gathering with friends and family, mixing tradition and camaraderie.

item.title: One of Maine’s most expensive road projects eyes spring groundbreaking
item.description: It’s more than six years after the anticipated groundbreaking of the 6.17-mile project, which is estimated to cost upwards of $84.3 million.
